IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI  A.B.A No. 5845 of 2023  Avinash Pathak --- --- Petitioner  Versus  1. The State of Jharkhand  2. Nikhil Kumari --- --- Opp. Parties  ---
CORAM:

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the Petitioner: Mr. Rana Surjit Singh, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Sudhir Kr. Mahto, A.P.P.
For the O.P. No. 2: Mr. Gaurav Kumar, Advocate ---
07 / 12.06.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sukhdev Nagar P.S. Case No. 104 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 376, 506 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Shri Kumar Saurabh Tripathi, learned Judicial Magistrate-III, Ranchi.
3. It appears that the petitioner has entered into consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix who is an adult lady.

It further appears that both were in live-in-relationship for seven years and thereafter, petitioner has refused to marry her.
4.
Mr. Gaurav Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

5. Considering the fact that the parties were in live-in-relationship for a considerable period of time,
I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, petitioner,
above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender, shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Shri Kumar Saurabh Tripathi, learned Judicial Magistrate-III, Ranchi
in connection with Sukhdev Nagar P.S. Case No. 104 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
